meta.description: Category 2 fact checklist: for each of the 4 source bundles (CAT2_PRESETS in app/data/cat2_fixtures.py), the facts a faithful draft for the stated target deliverable should carry. Derived ONLY from each preset's `payload` (incl. its target-deliverable / audience lines); written before any draft was read.
meta.matching: A fact is covered when ANY any_of alternative occurs in the rendered draft after both sides are normalised by app.archetypes.cat3_assistants.quality_rerun.normalise_text(), with that module's boundary guard (an alternative starting with a letter/digit must not be preceded by a letter/digit; one ending in a digit must not be followed by a digit).
meta.tier_rule: core = a decision-maker cannot act without it (headline metric, size of the exposure, the decision/ask, the hard deadline, the accountable owner where the source names one), judged from the source's own emphasis and its stated target deliverable; detail = supporting figures, components of a total, secondary names, mechanisms.
meta.alternative_rule: Every any_of alternative written at key time is a literal that occurs in its own payload after normalisation (tested). Alternatives added by the one dry pass over the drafts are format variants of the same value only; each is listed in format_variants_added_detail with the payload-literal alternative it is equivalent to (tested).

format_variants_added_detail.reason: two-decimal form of the same percentage ('11.50%'); alternative '11.5' fails the digit boundary guard there
WORDING variant (approved by lead 2026-11-25, see lead_rulings): same count with 'SKUs' elided ('334 compliant, 63 suspended and 15 delisted')
hyphenated form of the same 48h cap ('48-hour cap')
WORDING variant (approved by lead 2026-11-25, see lead_rulings): same count of the same accounts ('19 third-party IBAN routings')

meta.dry_pass_note: One pass over the 12 rendered drafts, looking only at facts a draft missed: draft numbers whose value equals the fact's value, date/time tokens for deadline facts, and the fact's distinctive words. No fact was added, dropped or re-tiered. Candidates rejected: '37Wh' label mentions for r1-air-block-37wh (different fact); '48 hours' (not needed, same value already matched by '48-hour').
